title: SAGE: From Direct Answering to Evidence-Grounded Inference for Chinese Ancient Document Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2608.24011v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Chinese ancient document understanding demands complex visual, linguistic, and historical reasoning. Current Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) typically rely on an opaque, single-pass generation paradigm, often producing overconfident and weakly grounded responses. To address this, we propose SAGE, an evidence-grounded multi-agent framework that reformulates Chinese ancient document understanding as evidence-grounded inference rather than direct answer generation. SAGE coordinates specialized agents for task-aware planning, tool-mediated evidence acquisition, claim-level verification, and bounded replanning under a constrained shared-state runtime. This design supports bounded evidence seeking, answer revision, and abstention when grounding is insufficient. Experiments on the AncientDoc benchmark show that SAGE consistently outperforms matched direct-answering baselines across three LVLM backbones. Remarkably, SAGE with Qwen3.5-9B s

translated_title: SAGE：从直接回答到证据支撑推理的中国古代文献理解
translated_abstract: 中国古代文献理解需要复杂的视觉、语言和历史推理能力。当前的大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）通常依赖不透明的单次生成范式，往往产生过于自信且缺乏依据的回应。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SAGE，一个基于证据的多智能体框架，将中国古代文献理解重新定义为基于证据的推理而非直接答案生成。SAGE协调专门智能体进行任务感知规划、工具介导的证据获取、声明级验证以及受限共享状态运行下的有界重规划。这种设计支持有界证据搜索、答案修正以及在依据不足时放弃回答。在AncientDoc基准上的实验表明，SAGE在三种LVLM骨干网络上始终优于匹配的直接回答基线。值得注意的是，使用Qwen3.5-9B的SAGE表现尤为突出。
tldr: SAGE提出了一种基于证据的多智能体框架，将中国古代文献理解从直接回答转变为证据支撑的推理，通过规划、证据获取和验证机制显著提升了模型的可靠性和准确性。
en_tdlr: SAGE proposes an evidence-grounded multi-agent framework that shifts Chinese ancient document understanding from direct answering to evidence-based inference, significantly improving reliability and accuracy through planning, evidence acquisition, and verification mechanisms.
